caption: Two rubber balls rolled toward each other across a gym floor meet off-centre and glance away from each other in new directions.

sa.check: Two rubber balls roll toward each other across a gym floor.
They glance away from each other in new directions.
Both balls change direction, not just one.
The approach comes first and the change of direction follows.

pc.expect: Both balls change direction at the instant they touch, move apart from the point of contact, and each is slower than before.
pc.fail: A ball changes course before the two touch; or the balls touch and both carry on in their old directions; or a ball leaves the contact quicker than it arrived.

pc.expect: The balls meet at their surfaces and stay outside each other.
pc.fail: The balls pass through each other; or they overlap and come out the other side; or they merge into a single ball at the contact.

pc.expect: After an off-centre meeting the two leave on different lines and spread apart.
pc.fail: The balls stick together and roll on as a pair; or both leave along exactly the line one of them came in on; or each comes straight back the way it came after a glancing touch.

pc.expect: On the open floor each ball rolls in a straight line and slows gradually.
pc.fail: A ball curves on the open floor with nothing touching it; or a ball gathers speed as it rolls; or a stopped ball sets off again untouched.

pc.expect: Two balls stay two balls on the floor.
pc.fail: A ball vanishes at the contact or a third appears; or a ball passes through the floor; or a ball turns into another object.

pc.expect: The balls' colours, the gym floor and the markings stay the same.
pc.fail: A ball changes colour at the contact; or the two balls swap colours; or the floor markings shift between frames.
